title: Prompts sealed to a key only you hold
lede: The gateway seals each record to your public key. Metadata stays in the clear so you can find a record; the content opens only in your browser, with a private key you supply at that moment. The sealing format is the lab's own. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: P1 Privilege Agent App seals each record
Record store: ciphertext and clear metadata
Agent Insights page in your browser
Your private key (stays in your browser)

steps.title: Traffic
steps.what: A prompt (and a response, if IncludeResponses is on) passes the gateway.

steps.title: Only the public half
steps.what: You make a key pair in the browser and give the gateway the public half as PublicKey. Without it nothing is recorded.

steps.title: Seal and store
steps.what: The gateway makes an ephemeral key, does ECDH with your public key, derives an AES-GCM key with HKDF and stores only ciphertext plus the clear metadata.

steps.title: Find the record
steps.what: You search who, which agent, which application, what was detected and what was decided. All clear text; nothing is decrypted.

steps.title: Bring your key
steps.what: You paste or load the private key into the page at the moment you open one record.

steps.title: Decrypt in the browser
steps.what: WebCrypto opens that one record. The server never sees the key or the plaintext; a record you never open is never decrypted anywhere.
